description: SessionStart context describing altimate-code's data tools (with the CLI routing guidance when the MCP server is unavailable or disallowed) that also copies the linked Altimate workspace's skills into `.claude/skills/`; a Stop hook that refreshes those skills in the background once they are an hour old; and an opt-in PreToolUse guard (active only when ALTIMATE_ROUTE_GUARD=1) that points direct warehouse client commands at `altimate tool run`.
